settings.heading: ADHD and Executive Functioning Evaluations
settings.subheading: ADHD and executive functioning evaluations are designed to provide diagnostic clarity when there are questions about attention, impulsivity, hyperactivity, organization, working memory, emotional regulation, task completion, academic functioning, or daily life demands. At Center for Balanced Living, ADHD evaluations are completed with clinical care and attention to the whole person. The goal is not simply to determine whether someone meets criteria for ADHD, but to understand how attention, executive functioning, learning, emotional regulation, anxiety, sleep, trauma, and environmental demands may be interacting.
